title: CSA Subscription Checklist
subtitle: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: CSA Subscription Checklist covers subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication. The CSA program coordinator records Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. CSA Subscription Checklist keeps Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription exceptions visible until the CSA program coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use CSA Subscription Checklist at farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff. Document subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication identity before Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription begins. Compare subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication findings with stated Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription criteria; route unresolved Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription issues to farm subscription operations reviewer.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription, identify responsible parties, farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff, and the linked subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication source.

fields.label: Share type, season, frequency, and payment plan
Pickup site, route, authorization, and preference

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription facts for subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Contents, quantity, timing, or handoff requirement
Observed pack, delivery, or contact result

blocks.label: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription inspection checks
items: Share contents and source lot where needed
Packing, hold, pickup, and authorized alternate
Missed pickup, substitution, credit, and donation rule
Season completion, balance, feedback, and renewal

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. CSA Program Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription when subscription terms, payment, pickup authority, communication, or share disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription proof and route unresolved subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication scope to CSA program coordinator.
